answer_1.quote: Summarization (SUM). This category requires the model to summarize the given long passage. For all the F-QA and ICL tasks, we adopt the F1 score of the generated tokens in comparison to the golden answers.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries and answers to questions

answer_2.quote: For all the F-QA and ICL tasks, we adopt the F1 score of the generated tokens in comparison to the golden answers. For all the SUM tasks, we adopt the ROUGE-L-Sum metric as in the previous work. For SYR-PASSKEY5/100/1000, SYR-RETRIEVE.KV, MC-QA (BESTCHOICE and EN.MC), LGR (CODE.DEBUG and MATH.FIND) datasets, we adopt Exact Match to calculate the correctness rate.

answer_3.quote: Specially, for the SYR-NEEDLE task, we also adopt a third LLM as a judge to score the answers, and the score is normalized from (1,10) to (0, 1). Clause 3 Sonnet is utilized as the judge.
